review_candidates.title: Project Manager / Proyectos Industriales y Energías Renovables (Madrid)
review_candidates.description: Desde Melt Group , buscamos un/a Project Manager para incorporarse a una multinacional europea especializada en soluciones de ingeniería y construcción para los sectores de las energías renovables, el biogás, el biometano y el tratamiento de aguas. La compañía cuenta con una sólida trayectoria internacional y desarrolla proyectos industriales en distintos países europeos, participando en la ejecución de instalaciones destinadas a la producción de energía renovable, la valorización de residuos y la gestión sostenible de recursos. En un contexto de crecimiento y expansión de sus proyectos en España, buscamos un/a profesional que asuma la responsabilidad de supervisar y coordinar la ejecución de los trabajos en obra, garantizando el cumplimiento de los plazos, los estándares de calidad, los requisitos de seguridad y los objetivos establecidos para cada proyecto. Principales responsabilidades: Gestión integral de obra: supervisar y coordinar la ejecución de los trabajos en campo, asegurando el cumplimiento de la planificación, los plazos y los objetivos del proyecto. Coordinación de equipos: organizar y supervisar a los equipos propios, subcontratas, proveedores y demás profesionales implicados en la ejecución de los trabajos. Seguimiento técnico: garantizar que los trabajos se ejecuten conforme a los planos, las especificaciones técnicas, los procedimientos establecidos y los estándares de calidad requeridos. Planificación y control: realizar el seguimiento del avance de obra, identificar posibles desviaciones y proponer medidas correctivas para asegurar el cumplimiento del calendario previsto. Control de costes y recursos: colaborar en el seguimiento de los recursos materiales, humanos y técnicos necesarios para la correcta ejecución del proyecto. Seguridad y prevención: velar por el cumplimiento de las normas de prevención de riesgos laborales, seguridad y salud en obra, así como de los procedimientos internos. Gestión de incidencias: identificar y resolver problemas técnicos u operativos, coordinándose con los departamentos de ingeniería, compras, planificación y dirección de proyecto. Requisitos del puesto: Formación técnica en Ingeniería Industrial, Ingeniería Civil, Ingeniería Mecánica, Ingeniería de la Construcción o disciplinas relacionadas. Experiencia previa como Site Manager, Jefe/a de Obra, Construction Manager o en posiciones similares dentro de proyectos industriales, energéticos o de construcción. Experiencia demostrable en la supervisión y coordinación de trabajos en obra, gestión de subcontratas y seguimiento de proyectos. Se valorará especialmente la experiencia en proyectos de energías renovables, biogás, biometano, plantas industriales, instalaciones de tratamiento de aguas o infraestructuras medioambientales . Capacidad para interpretar planos, documentación técnica, especificaciones y planificación de obra. Conocimientos de planificación, control de costes, gestión de recursos y seguimiento de avances. Conocimiento de la normativa de seguridad y prevención de riesgos laborales aplicable a trabajos de construcción. Nivel alto de inglés, imprescindible , tanto para la comunicación oral como escrita, la coordinación con equipos internacionales y el seguimiento de la documentación técnica. Residencia en Madrid o disponibilidad para establecerse en la zona. Disponibilidad para desplazarse a las obras y adaptarse a las necesidades operativas de los proyectos. Perfil organizado, resolutivo y autónomo, con capacidad de liderazgo, planificación y toma de decisiones en campo. Qué ofrece la compañía? Incorporación a una multinacional europea con presencia internacional y proyectos vinculados a la transición energética y la sostenibilidad. Participación en proyectos técnicos especializados dentro de un sector con importantes perspectivas de crecimiento. Salario competitivo, acorde con la experiencia y las responsabilidades del puesto. Retribución variable vinculada a objetivos, según las condiciones de la compañía. Desarrollo profesional y oportunidades de crecimiento dentro de una organización internacional. Entorno de trabajo dinámico, con colaboración entre equipos multidisciplinares y exposición a proyectos de diferente alcance. Plan de carrera a medio y largo plazo, con posibilidades de asumir mayores responsabilidades en futuros proyectos.

review_candidates.title: Project Head Government Projects
review_candidates.description: Company Description Highway Infrastructure Limited is a construction company with over 23 years of experience delivering roadways, highways, bypasses, expressways, bridges, and residential projects. Known for its focus on quality, innovation, and transparent practices, the company has built strong client relationships and a solid reputation in Indore, Madhya Pradesh. Highway Infrastructure Limited is committed to developing infrastructure that supports economic growth and community development. As the organization expands, it continues to offer opportunities for professionals who want to contribute to impactful, large-scale projects. Role Description The Project Head is a full-time, on-site role based in Bhopal, responsible for overseeing end-to-end planning, execution, and delivery of highway and infrastructure projects. The role involves managing project schedules, budgets, and resources, coordinating with site engineers, contractors, vendors, and clients, and ensuring compliance with safety, quality, and regulatory standards. The Project Head will review technical designs and drawings, monitor progress against milestones, resolve operational issues, and implement risk mitigation strategies. Day-to-day responsibilities also include leading project review meetings, preparing status reports, optimizing construction processes, and supporting senior management in strategic decision-making related to project portfolios. Qualifications Strong project management capabilities, including planning, scheduling, budgeting, and risk management for large infrastructure or construction projects. Technical expertise in civil engineering, highway or bridge construction, and familiarity with relevant codes, standards, and regulatory requirements. Proven leadership and team management skills, with experience supervising multidisciplinary site teams and coordinating with stakeholders. Excellent communication and negotiation skills for client interaction, contractor management, and cross-functional collaboration. Proficiency with project management and construction-related software tools (e.g., MS Project, Primavera, AutoCAD or similar). Ability to analyze project data, prepare reports, and make data-informed decisions to improve efficiency and quality. Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering or a related discipline; advanced certifications in project management (e.g., PMP, PRINCE2) are an advantage. Demonstrated experience (typically 10+ years) in managing large-scale infrastructure projects, preferably in highways or related sectors. Commitment to workplace safety, ethical practices, and continuous improvement in construction processes.

review_candidates.title: Private Sector Engagement Manager
review_candidates.description: IPE Global’s Social and Economic Empowerment (SEE) practice works towards building girl capital, empowering women and nurturing resilient communities by creating inclusive and sustainable solutions, including but not limited to policy development, capacity building, adaptive management, community mobilisation, behaviour change communication, deepening social safety nets, beneficiary feedback analysis, poverty assessment, and evidence-based monitoring. Under the SEE practice, IPE Global is implementing She Works (2025-2030), a programme aimed at increasing women's access to paid employment. In Uttar Pradesh, under the She Works programme, IPE Global has partnered with the State Transformation Commission (STC), Government of Uttar Pradesh , to increase female labour force participation (FLFP) in paid employment across the state. As part of this partnership, an FLFP Cell has been set up at the STC to drive convergence across government departments, and private sector action on women’s employment. IPE Global is hiring a Private Sector Engagement Manager who will anchor state-level industry engagement for She Works programme in Uttar Pradesh, working closely with the State Transformation Commission (STC), Invest UP, the Industries Department, the MSME & Export Promotion Department, and industry associations to increase women's employment opportunities and improve workplace conditions across the state. The role will be embedded within government—working out of Invest UP, STC or the MSME Department depending on traction and work requirements—and will design and implement a UP-specific private-sector strategy that draws on the state's investment promotion, industrial and MSME ecosystem to onboard companies, secure diversity pledges, strengthen gender-responsive practices at the firm level, and build long-term partnerships with industry networks. Key Responsibilities Lead the development and execution of a UP-specific private-sector strategy to increase women's employment across priority sectors and clusters, including manufacturing, electronics, textiles and apparel, food processing, logistics, and One District One Product (ODOP) clusters. Work from within Invest UP, STC or the MSME Department (as determined by traction and work requirements), providing embedded technical support to integrate women’s employment objectives into investment facilitation, industrial development initiatives, and MSME programmes. Coordinate with STC, Invest UP, the Industries Department, and the MSME & Export Promotion Department , along with allied departments such as Labour, Vocational Education & Skill Development (UPSDM) and Women & Child Development, to align employer engagement with the She Works State Action Plan. Leverage Invest UP's investor facilitation pipeline—including MoUs signed at investor summits and projects under ground-breaking ceremonies—to engage new and expanding investors on women's hiring commitments , workforce planning and gender-inclusive workplace standards. Support the integration of gender-inclusive provisions (e.g., incentives for women's employment, workplace safety, and enabling infrastructure such as working women's · hostels and transport) into state industrial, sectoral and MSME frameworks and their operational guidelines. Build and manage partnerships with national, state and sector-specific industry associations (e.g., CII, FICCI, PHDCCI, ASSOCHAM, Indian Industries Association) to onboard employers and drive gender-inclusive practices. Roll out the state diversity pledges , track company progress, and support the creation of state-level recognition mechanisms for gender-inclusive employers. Engage MSMEs and cluster associations —including ODOP clusters and industrial areas—to pilot practical, low-cost gender-inclusive HR and workplace solutions suited to smaller enterprises. Promote gender-friendly certifications and diversity indices among private employers to drive widespread recognition and compliance. Facilitate state-level industry roundtables and district/cluster dialogues—with STC, Invest UP, the Industries and MSME Departments, and industry associations —to drive sector-wide adoption of gender-inclusive practices across the state. Design a state-level recognition mechanism, in partnership with Invest UP, the MSME Department and industry bodies, to acknowledge companies that achieve or exceed their diversity pledge commitments. Capture field insights, document best practices, and support state-level monitoring and reporting mechanisms for adaptive programme learning, including inputs to STC and departmental review meetings. Document UP-specific case studies of companies and clusters that successfully adopt gender-inclusive hiring and workplace practices, and share them through government review meetings, Invest UP and MSME platforms, and industry forums. As job descriptions cannot be exhaustive, the Manager may be required to undertake other duties that are broadly in line with the above key responsibilities as determined by the senior leadership. Qualification & Experience Educational Background Master’s degree or higher in Business Administration, Gender/ Development Studies, Human Resource Management, Economics or a related field. Work Experience: At least 8 years of professional work experience in engaging with corporates, industry associations, government departments, and donor agencies on women's economic empowerment, investment promotion, MSME development or private sector development. Demonstrated experience working with or within state government institutions (e.g., investment promotion agencies, Industries/MSME departments, and transformation units), preferably in Uttar Pradesh. Track record of engaging with senior industry leaders and influencing organizational change. Strong understanding of gender and labour market dynamics in India, and of Uttar Pradesh's industrial, investment and MSME landscape. Technical Expertise: Deep knowledge of gender-responsive approaches to private sector development and employment. Familiarity with state industrial, investment and MSME policies and schemes, ESG/BRSR principles, and inclusive value chains. Key Skills and Competencies Strategic Thinking & Innovation: Ability to design and drive complex partnership models for social impact. Negotiation & Influence : Skilled in building high-level alliances with government and private players. Government Liaison & Embedded Working : Ability to work effectively from within government offices, navigate inter-departmental processes, and build trust with senior officials. Communication : Excellent written and spoken English and Hindi; able to present to senior government and industry audiences. Gender and Inclusion Lens : Experience integrating gender-transformative approaches into public-private programs. Our commitments: We offer competitive compensation and a comprehensive benefits package. We are committed to diversity in our workforce and are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. You will work with sector experts and understand how people-centered policies can be created and effectively implemented. With us, you will master framing narratives and counterpoints and pace storytelling for internal and external stakeholders.

review_candidates.title: Platform Deployment Engineer (AI Factory Delivery)
review_candidates.description: 🗓️ Full-time | Permanent 📍 Remote, in the same time zone as the rest of the squad 🏡 Remote working About Sharon AI Sharon AI is an Australian neocloud, delivering trusted AI infrastructure organisations need to build, train and run AI at scale. We support customers across the full AI lifecycle, from training through to inference and agentic AI, drawing on a strong ecosystem of technology and co-location partners to deliver capability where it's needed. As the first neocloud to join NVIDIA's AI Compute Program, we're growing quickly, scaling our AI Factory platform to meet rising demand for advanced compute. The Role As Sharon AI continues to grow, we're looking for a talented Platform Deployment Engineer to join our regional Delivery squad and play an important role in deploying and delivering the platform layer of our AI Factories, reporting to our Regional Delivery Manager. AI Factories are the high-performance GPU compute environments that underpin Sharon AI's AI cloud, serving customers and internal teams running large-scale training, fine-tuning and inference. In this role, the Platform Deployment Engineer will take the orchestration, scheduling and self-service layer of each AI Factory from build through to customer acceptance, so the platform is ready for customers and for Operations from day one. You'll both deploy and test, and look for ways to make each deployment faster than the last. You'll work closely with Network and Infrastructure Deployment Engineers, on-site Data Centre Deployment Engineers, the Platform team and Operations, with exposure to cutting-edge technology at the forefront of AI infrastructure. What You'll Be Doing Bringing each AI Factory under Rafay, and standing up and tuning Kubernetes clusters (and Slurm where used) with GPU nodes to meet agreed design and performance targets Deploying the NVIDIA GPU Operator and other platform components at the version-locked set Configuring workload scheduling, resource allocation, and multi-tenant security and isolation in line with each AI Factory's design Configuring and validating self-service APIs, CLI and portal access for GPU provisioning, and integrating observability and monitoring so each AI Factory is visible to Operations from day one Planning and executing platform testing, including acceptance testing (ATP), integrated system testing (IST), GPU performance and NCCL benchmarks, and multi-hour training jobs across the cluster Supporting customer site acceptance testing, recording results against pass/fail thresholds and fixing defects before handover Working with on-site staff and the data centre provider's remote hands for any physical task, such as reseating, part swaps or console access Delivering repeatable deployments using infrastructure-as-code (Ansible and Terraform) and shared deployment scripts, timing each step and proposing changes that shorten the cycle Feeding lessons learned back into standard playbooks and tooling, and to the Platform team for its designs and configurations Preparing handover documentation, runbooks and as-built records, and transferring knowledge to Operations and the Platform team Supporting Operations during the hypercare window (up to one month), on call for build defects, and reporting progress, risks and issues to the Regional Delivery Manager What We're Looking For 4 to 8+ years' experience in platform engineering or SRE Strong experience with Kubernetes and GPU workloads in production Experience working with cloud-native infrastructure at scale Strong experience with Ansible and Terraform, and programming in Python, Go or Bash Experience with CI/CD and infrastructure automation Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field Strong communication and stakeholder management skills Ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment A proactive, collaborative and solutions-focused approach Strong attention to detail A genuine interest in AI, technology and what Sharon AI is building Nice to have: Rafay or similar multi-cluster platform experience GPU cloud or HPC platform experience, and GPU technologies such as CUDA and NCCL ML frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow) and MLOps tools (Ray, Kubeflow, Airflow) CKA or cloud certifications Why Join Sharon AI? You'll be joining a rapidly growing Australian technology business at an exciting stage of its journey, with the opportunity to work directly with the infrastructure and technology powering the next generation of AI. 🏡 Remote working – work from wherever suits you, in the same time zone as your squad 🎂 Birthday leave – take some extra time to celebrate your day 🧠 Employee Assistance Program (EAP) – confidential support when you need it 🤖 Exposure to AI and next-generation technology – work in one of the fastest-moving areas of technology 🎓 Learning & development – we support your career growth with approved conferences, professional memberships & courses 🚗 Novated leasing – a tax-effective way to finance and run your car 🎁 Bounty referral program – generous rewards for successfully referring new talent to Sharon AI 🏆 Employee of the month – recognition plus a $500 gift card 🌏 Growing global business – be part of an Australian technology company with an expanding international footprint 💡 Make an impact – join at a stage where your work can have a visible influence on how we build and grow 🤝 Collaborative culture – work alongside talented people across technical, commercial and corporate teams Our Values Integrity | Innovation | Collaboration | Wellbeing | Inclusion Apply today and help us build the infrastructure powering the next generation of AI. Due to the high volume of applications we receive, we're unfortunately not always able to provide individual feedback to unsuccessful candidates. We appreciate your understanding and want to assure you that every application will be reviewed with care.

review_candidates.title: Planning & Monitoring Officer (NO-2), TA (364 days), #00138680, Cox's Bazaar - Bangladesh, APR (open to nationals of Bangladesh)
review_candidates.description: Apply now Job no: 596290 Contract type: Temporary Appointment Duty Station: Cox's Bazaar Location: Bangladesh Categories: Research, Planning, Monitoring and Evaluation UNICEF works in over 190 countries and territories to save children’s lives, defend their rights, and help them fulfill their potential, from early childhood through adolescence. At UNICEF, we are committed, passionate, and proud of what we do for as long as we are needed. Promoting the rights of every child is not just a job – it is a calling. UNICEF is a place where careers are built: we offer our staff diverse opportunities for professional and personal development that will help them reinforce a sense of purpose while serving children and communities across the world. We welcome everyone who wants to belong and grow in a diverse and passionate culture, coupled with an attractive compensation and benefits package. Visit our website to learn more about what we do at UNICEF. For every child, the right to Opportunity Job Context The fundamental mission of UNICEF is to promote the rights of every child, everywhere, in everything the organization does — in programs, in advocacy and in operations. The equity strategy, emphasizing the most disadvantaged and excluded children and families, translates this commitment to children’s rights into action. For UNICEF, equity means that all children have an opportunity to survive, develop and reach their full potential, without discrimination, bias or favoritism. To the degree that any child has an unequal chance in life — in its social, political, economic, civic and cultural dimensions — her or his rights are violated. There is growing evidence that investing in the health, education and protection of a society’s most disadvantaged citizens — addressing inequity — not only will give all children the opportunity to fulfill their potential but also will lead to sustained growth and stability of countries. This is why the focus on equity is so vital. It accelerates progress towards realizing the human rights of all children, which is the universal mandate of UNICEF, as outlined by the Convention on the Rights of the Child, while also supporting the equitable development of nations. Purpose Of Assignment Bangladesh continues to host 1,204,492 Rohingya refugees from Myanmar in 33 camps in Cox’s Bazar District and Bhasan Char of Noakhali District, 51 per cent of them are children. As part of the Rohingya refugee relocation plan by the Government of Bangladesh to Bhasan Char, 33,659 refugees have been relocated to the island as of 31 July 2026. The Rohingya refugee camps are overcrowded and have other physical challenges that limit refugees' access to education, protection, food, water, shelter, and health services. This raises risks of mortality, morbidity and protection violations and affects people's well-being, with women and children continuing to face multiple deprivations and increasing needs. While humanitarian su-pport has decreased in the past year, refugees remain reliant on significant humanitarian assistance, particularly to access essential services. The protracted Rohingya refugee crisis is a major humanitarian emergency with world's largest refugee settlement. In 2025, UNICEF reached 414,373 Rohingya refugees through multi-sectoral services. UNICEF has established partnerships with local, national, and international NGOs, as well as relevant government departments, to facilitate the delivery of interventions and services. However, the highly intensive humanitarian interventions in Rohingya Refugee Camps and Host communities in Cox’s Bazar have presented challenges for UNICEF staff in conducting representative samples during regular field visits to monitor their programme. In response to these challenges, UNICEF Cox’s Bazar office has onboarded a TPM services provider to support this, UNICEF seeks to hire a Monitoring and Data Analyst to enhance coordination between the Programme Sections and Third-Party Monitors (TPMs) and quality assurance of programme monitoring. Major Duties And Responsibilities PLANNING AND COLLABORATION HUMANITARIAN PROGRAMME PERFORMANCE AND RESULTS MONITORING PROGRAMME IMPLEMENTATION MONITORING AND RESULT MONITORNG PLANNING AND MONITORING CAPACITY BUILDING COORDINATION AND NETWORKING If you would like to know more about this position, please review the complete Job Description here: Job Description_TOR_Planning and Monitoring Officer, TA, NO2, Cox's Bazaar.pdf To qualify as an advocate for every child you will have… Minimum Requirements Education: First level university degree (Bachelor’s degree or equivalent) in social sciences, social work, statistics, development studies or a related field is required. Work Experience: Minimum 2 years of relevant professional experience in programme implementation monitoring, reporting, and performance management in development and/or humanitarian contexts; experience within the UN system is highly desirable. Strong analytical, report-writing, and presentation skills are essential. Skills: Performance Monitoring & Reporting, Planning, Data Management, TPM, MS Excel, SPSS, Power BI, Quality Assurance, Statistical Analysis Language Requirements: English - Proficient/Fluent is required. Desirables Language: Knowledge of another official UN language (Arabic, Chinese, French, Russian or Spanish) or a local language is considered an asset. Demonstrated experience in humanitarian and emergency programming, including emergency preparedness and response, with active involvement in humanitarian crisis response initiatives considered an asset. Advanced proficiency in MS Excel and SPSS, with working knowledge of Power BI for data management, analysis, visualization, and performance reporting. Strong technical expertise in quantitative, qualitative, and mixed-methods approaches, including data quality assurance, validity and reliability testing, statistical analysis, interpretation of findings, and the application of appropriate analytical tools and methodologies. Proven ability to synthesize and analyze data from multiple sources, develop compelling analytical reports and presentations, and translate complex evidence into clear insights to support programme performance monitoring and decision-making. Demonstrated experience in contract management and coordination with Third-Party Monitoring (TPM) agencies, implementing partners, or other external service providers, including oversight of monitoring activities and deliverables. Strong research and analytical skills, with a proven ability to aggregate, synthesize, and communicate key findings, lessons learned, and actionable recommendations from diverse evidence and information sources. For every Child, you demonstrate... UNICEF's Core Values of Care, Respect, Integrity, Trust and Accountability and Sustainability (CRITAS) underpin everything we do and how we do it. Get acquainted with Our Values Charter: UNICEF Values UNICEF Competencies Required For This Post Are… Builds and maintains partnerships Demonstrates self-awareness and ethical awareness Drive to achieve results for impact Innovates and embraces change Manages ambiguity and complexity Thinks and acts strategically Works collaboratively with others Familiarize yourself with our competency framework and its different levels. UNICEF promotes and advocates for the protection of the rights of every child, everywhere, in everything it does and is mandated to support the realization of the rights of every child, including those most disadvantaged, and our global workforce must reflect the diversity of those children. The UNICEF family is committed to include everyone, irrespective of their race/ethnicity, disability, gender identity, sexual orientation, religion, nationality, socio-economic background, minority, or any other status. UNICEF encourages applications from all qualified candidates, regardless of gender, nationality, religious or ethnic backgrounds, and from people with disabilities, including neurodivergence. We offer a wide range of benefits to our staff, including paid parental leave, breastfeeding breaks and reasonable accommodation for persons with disabilities. UNICEF provides reasonable accommodation throughout the recruitment process. If you require any accommodation, please submit your request through the accessibility email button on the UNICEF Careers webpage Accessibility | UNICEF. Should you be shortlisted, please get in touch with the recruiter directly to share further details, enabling us to make the necessary arrangements in advance. UNICEF does not hire candidates who are married to children (persons under 18). UNICEF has a zero-tolerance policy on conduct that is incompatible with the aims and objectives of the United Nations and UNICEF, including sexual exploitation and abuse, sexual harassment, abuse of authority, discrimination, fraud, corruption and other forms of serious misconduct. UNICEF is committed to promoting the protection and safeguarding of all children. All selected candidates will undergo rigorous reference, safeguarding and background verification checks. These checks may include verification of academic credentials and employment history, screening against relevant United Nations misconduct databases, and requests for misconduct disclosures from current and former employers, professional associations, other relevant organizations and participating organizations under inter-agency safeguarding initiatives, including the Misconduct Disclosure Scheme (MDS), where applicable. UNICEF does not charge a processing fee at any stage of its recruitment, selection, and hiring processes (i.e., application stage, interview stage, validation stage, or appointment and training). Therefore, all staff, at all levels across all functional areas, can be called upon to be deployed to support humanitarian response, contributing to both strengthening resilience of communities and capacity of national authorities. Principales responsabilidades Diseño y cálculo de instalaciones eléctricas de baja tensión asociadas a estaciones base de telefonía móvil. Cálculo y dimensionamiento de líneas eléctricas, secciones de conductores y canalizaciones. Cálculo de caídas de tensión, intensidades, potencia instalada y demanda prevista . Selección y dimensionamiento de protecciones eléctricas: magnetotérmicos, diferenciales, fusibles y protecciones contra sobretensiones. Diseño y cálculo de cuadros eléctricos y cuadros de distribución . Elaboración y revisión de esquemas unifilares . Diseño y dimensionamiento de sistemas de puesta a tierra y equipotencialidad . Diseño de sistemas de protección frente a sobretensiones y coordinación de protecciones. Cálculo y comprobación de instalaciones conforme al REBT y normativa técnica aplicable . Definición de soluciones de alimentación para equipos de telecomunicaciones, rectificadores, sistemas DC, baterías y equipos auxiliares. Análisis de necesidades eléctricas para ampliaciones o incorporación de nuevos equipos en estaciones existentes. Elaboración de planos, memorias técnicas, cálculos justificativos y documentación de ingeniería. Revisión de documentación existente y realización de propuestas de adecuación de instalaciones. Soporte técnico a los equipos de Site Design, construcción e instalación. Perfil requerido Titulación universitaria en Ingeniería Eléctrica, Ingeniería Industrial o especialidad equivalente. Conocimientos sólidos de instalaciones eléctricas de Baja Tensión. Conocimiento del Reglamento Electrotécnico para Baja Tensión (REBT) y normativa asociada. Capacidad para realizar cálculos eléctricos y justificar técnicamente las soluciones propuestas. Manejo de AutoCAD o herramientas similares para elaboración y revisión de planos. Se valorará especialmente Experiencia previa en proyectos de telecomunicaciones y estaciones base de telefonía móvil . Conocimientos de sistemas de alimentación AC/DC, rectificadores, baterías y sistemas de respaldo utilizados en telecomunicaciones. Nivel de inglés suficiente para trabajar con documentación técnica y equipos internacionales. Qué ofrecemos Participación en proyectos nacionales e internacionales. Trabajo conjunto con equipos especializados en Site Design, ingeniería estructural, construcción y telecomunicaciones. Posibilidad de desarrollo profesional dentro del área de ingeniería. Ubicación del trabajo: Teletrabajo híbrido en Málaga, Granada, Córdoba o Almería.

review_candidates.title: Humanitarian Adviser
review_candidates.description: Main purpose of job: Support the UK Humanitarian Advisor to monitor and assess the humanitarian situation in South Sudan; reflect this in evolving policy, strategy and programme priorities; and communicate effectively with UK Government stakeholders. Help the UK Team Leader to strengthen the effectiveness of the humanitarian response in South Sudan by positioning the UK at the forefront of humanitarian advocacy with the UN and wider international community. Lead one or more of UK technical priorities, including preparedness, famine prevention, nutrition, protection and/or humanitarian access in the humanitarian response. Help the ‘Senior Responsible Owner’ and wider team ensure delivery of FCDO South Sudan’s humanitarian programme is robust, delivers value for money and achieves its intended results, through working closely with partners and programme management and advisory colleagues. Roles and responsibilities: The post reports to the G7 Humanitarian Adviser. The postholder will be a member of the Humanitarian and Human Development Team and work closely with colleagues across the Embassy. In this role you will be responsible for: Assessment and analysis: Maintain situational awareness through regular assessment and analysis of needs and corresponding response, including through field visits where viable. Monitor and analyse the humanitarian situation, communicating effectively with Embassy colleagues to inform humanitarian diplomacy and to effectively influence the necessary evolution or changes of policy, strategy and programme priorities. Policy and advocacy: Assess and contribute to advocacy strategies, working closely with UN, Red Cross and NGO partners, including on food security, nutrition, protection and access and UK humanitarian reform priorities. Directly advocate for UK humanitarian policy objectives through various senior forums both internally and externally, engaging with FCDO’s Humanitarian Department, Research and Evidence Directorate and other relevant policy leads elsewhere to ensure policy work is informing and learning from UK humanitarian policy as it develops. Programme delivery: Provide technical support and advice into the design, appraisal, delivery, monitoring, evaluation and learning of humanitarian projects and programmes. Contribute to ensure delivery of humanitarian programmes is robust, compliant with corporate standards, delivers value for money and achieves its intended results to the appropriate quality standards, working closely with the programme team, other advisers and partners. Partnerships and networks: Establish constructive relationships and build networks with key individuals and organisations as a basis for information gathering and triangulation, as well as forward thinking for changing contexts and needs. Represent FCDO with relevant partners and in relevant forums. People and building capability: Maintain cutting edge understanding of and application of evidence and work to build the capability of others. Provide up to 10% time to support FCDO’s wider humanitarian objectives. Technical Competencies: Prioritise humanitarian assistance to people in greatest need and provide them with what they need the most to recover from crises. Protect the people most at risk, including from conflict-related sexual violence and barriers to humanitarian assistance. Reform: Humanitarian theory, architecture and system effectiveness. Prevent and anticipate future shocks and build resilience in long-running crises by tackling the underlying drivers of crises, instability, and extreme food insecurity. Further information on technical humanitarian competencies can be found here: https://assets.publishing.service.gov.uk/media/66f1577f08a2c7f27217e26c/Technical_Competency_Framework_Humanitarian_Sept_24.odt Your application should clearly demonstrate how you meet these competencies. Essential qualifications, skills and experience Relevant experience working on humanitarian programmes in South Sudan Previous experience of providing technical humanitarian analysis and advice Strong understanding of South Sudan's humanitarian architecture and key stakeholders Specific technical background and/or experience in one or more of the following fields: food security, nutrition, protection, humanitarian access, inclusion and accountability. Excellent inter-personal and team working and communication skills, with an ability to work flexibly and adapt to emerging issues. Desirable qualifications, skills and experience Approximately 5 years or more of relevant humanitarian experience to show sufficient evidence of the required competencies. A Masters qualification is desirable, but relevant experience can be considered in lieu of this.
